Container.Name: beetjuice
Container.Overview: Web UI for browsing and managing a beets music library. Handles duplicate detection, library browsing, and safe file deletion. Companion to beets-flask (which handles importing). Requires the beets web plugin running with readonly: no.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the beetjuice web interface.

Config.Name: Beets API URL
Config.Description: URL of the beets web plugin. If beetjuice and beets share a Docker network, use the container name (e.g. http://beets:8337). Otherwise use your server IP and port.

Config.Name: Music Path (internal)
Config.Description: Internal container path where your music share is mounted. Used as the safety boundary — beetjuice will never delete files outside this path.

Config.Name: Beets Library Path
Config.Description: Root of your beets library inside the container. Set this if beets returns relative paths or uses a subdirectory of your music share (e.g. /music/clean). Leave blank if beets returns absolute paths that already start with MUSIC_PATH.

Config.Name: Music Library
Config.Description: Path to your music library on the Unraid host. Mount the same share your beets container uses. Read-write access is required for file deletion.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file operations. 99 = nobody on Unraid (standard).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file operations. 100 = users on Unraid (standard).

Config.Name: Internal Port
Config.Description: Internal port beetjuice listens on. Only change if you have a port conflict and understand the implications.
